svg.title: AQUARIUS — SECTIONS
svg.text: SECTIONS A-A · B-B · C-C — LEVELS FFL 0.00 / +3.60 / +4.00 / +6.50 / +8.00
SECTION A-A — FRONT, AT GRID 4 LOOKING NORTH
west - east · cut through Hallway 1, both arenas, both bases · 101/104 CLR 3.60 UNDER DECK, 102/103 CLR 8.00
SECTION B-B — SIDE, AT GRID E LOOKING WEST
south - north · cut through the BRIDGE and both long hallways · bridge deck T.O. +4.00 over Hallway 1
SECTION C-C — THROUGH HALLWAY 2 LOOKING NORTH (THE TWO-LEVEL SIDE LANE)
west - east · lane floor FFL 0.00 with the walk deck over at +4.00 (founder-annotated upper level)
DO NOT SCALE — USE FIGURED DIMENSIONS. UNITS: METERS.
FFL 0.00 / T.O. DECK +4.00 / T.O. WALL +8.00. PLAN SCALE DERIVED.
